title: OSError and decode errors escape main as tracebacks
description:
main() in git-vouch (3220) and git-vouch-migrate (1122) catch only VouchError, but several I/O paths raise other exceptions unwrapped:

- git-vouch-migrate:559-560 (port: (out/'people').mkdir, write_bytes) and 969-971 (drafts: path.parent.mkdir, write_bytes): PermissionError/ENOSPC give a traceback. Worse, the --out directory is already created, so the retry is refused by the out.exists() guard (995, 1028) until the user deletes the partial directory by hand.
- git-vouch:2331-2358 _fetch (copy.mkdir, info/ mkdir, attributes write_text, vouch-url read_text/write_text, vouch-fetched touch), reached from cmd_sync/cmd_setup: an unwritable or full XDG_DATA_HOME gives a traceback.
- git-vouch:2302-2305 _fetched catches only FileNotFoundError around stat; PermissionError escapes.
- git-vouch:2290 _config and 2204 _output_path: proc.stdout.decode() strict; a non-UTF-8 git config value (path) raises UnicodeDecodeError.

Why it matters: users see a Python stack instead of 'git-vouch: error: ...', and for migrate a transient write failure leaves state that blocks the documented retry.

Fix: wrap these sites as the rest of the file does (except OSError as e: raise VouchError(...) from e); decode config with errors='surrogateescape' or wrap UnicodeDecodeError; in migrate, write drafts into a temp dir beside --out and rename it into place at the end, so a failure leaves no --out.
notes:
Done (unit mig-hygiene, commit 2902090): git-vouch-migrate port/drafts write --out via temp dir + rename, clean error, retry works; tests test_port.py/test_drafts.py::test_failed_write_leaves_no_out_and_retry_works. Remaining: the git-vouch core sites in the description (_fetch, _fetched PermissionError, _config/_output_path decode), owned by the core unit; close when those land.
Core part fixed (unit core-misc, uncommitted): cmd_sync wraps _fetch OSError/UnicodeDecodeError; _fetched turns non-ENOENT OSError into VouchError; _config/_output_path decode --type=path values with surrogateescape, other non-UTF-8 values give a clean error; main also catches OSError as a backstop. Tests: test_sync.py::test_unwritable_data_dir_is_a_clean_error, ::test_unreadable_fetch_time_is_a_clean_error, ::test_registry_url_not_utf8_is_a_clean_error; test_export.py::test_output_path_from_git_config_need_not_be_utf8.
close_reason: git-vouch part (migrate part done in 2902090): _config/_output_path path values decoded with surrogateescape, other non-UTF-8 config a clean error; _fetch OSError/UnicodeDecodeError and _fetched stat errors are clean errors; tests test_output_path_from_git_config_need_not_be_utf8, test_sync_output_paths_need_not_be_utf8, test_registry_url_not_utf8_is_a_clean_error, test_saved_registry_url_not_utf8_is_a_clean_error, test_check_a_worktree_under_a_non_utf8_directory, test_unwritable_data_dir_is_a_clean_error, test_unreadable_fetch_time_is_a_clean_error
